title: galium lappaceum
intro: Galium lappaceum, commonly known as Lappaceum or Indian Alum, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. It is a herb used in Ayurvedic medicine, valued for its diverse health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Galium lappaceum include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antibacterial properties, which help to soothe and protect the skin. The bioactive constituents present in Galium lappaceum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable natural remedy.
